name: laikait/laika-queue
description: Queue package for the Laika PHP MVC Framework — database, Redis, and JSON drivers with a signal-aware worker.

suggest.ext-pcntl: Enables graceful shutdown and per-job timeout in Worker (Linux/macOS only)
suggest.ext-posix: Required alongside pcntl for signal handling (Linux/macOS only)
suggest.laikait/laika-core: Makes QueueModelSchema/FailedJobModelSchema discoverable by `php laika app:migrate` — not needed to use DatabaseDriver standalone
